sanskrit: pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no 'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari . ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ
english: Flow forth, O rain-giver; bring us the wave of the waters from heaven. May the abundant nourishments be free of disease.

sanskrit: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman . janyāsa upa no gṛham
english: Flow forth with that stream by which the cattle have come hither, and the people to our home.

sanskrit: ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ . asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava
english: Flow as clarified butter in a stream, O most desired of the gods in sacrifices. Flow down your rain for us.

sanskrit: sa na ūrje vyā3vyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā . devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam
english: Run through the purifying filter in a stream for our strength and vigor. The gods shall indeed hear him.

sanskrit: pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat . pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ
english: The purifying Soma has flowed forth, has driven away the demons, illuminating the lights of praise as in ancient times.

sanskrit: araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścādadhvane naraḥ
english: For him who is fit to go, who has set out on the path that never retreats, O men.

sanskrit: emenaṃ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam . amatrebhirṛjīṣiṇamindraṃ sutebhirindubhiḥ
english: Come forth to meet him, the greatest drinker of Soma, with the Soma juices; meet Indra, who bears the Soma dregs, with the pressed drops in the vessels.

sanskrit: yadī sutebhirindubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha . vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣattantamideṣate
english: If you adorn yourselves with the pressed drops, the Soma juices, the wise one who knows all things goes boldly forth to him.

sanskrit: asmāasmā idandhaso 'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam . kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardhato 'bhiśasteravasvarat
english: For this one and that one, O Adhvaryu, carry forth the pressed Soma as food. Whether perchance of his noble, vigorous troop, he shall sound forth against the reviler.

sanskrit: apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ somāya gāthamarcata
english: Drive away the dog who lacks generosity; smite the arrogant one as the Bhṛgus did. Sing a hymn to Soma.

sanskrit: ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ . sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana . madhāvā dhāvatā madhu
english: He has clothed himself in the mantle of his kinsmen, like a son in the lap of the two parents. He who flows like a lover to the women, like a suitor taking his seat in the womb — purify with the stones released from the hand the pressed Soma. Flow, O honey-bearers, with honey.

sanskrit: sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī . hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana . indumindre dadhātana
english: He is the hero, the accomplisher of might, who has propped apart the two worlds. The tawny one has clothed himself in the purifying filter; like a priest he has taken his seat in the womb. Sit down with reverence; curdle it toward the curd. Set the drop in Indra.

sanskrit: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave . devebhyo anukāmakṛt
english: Flow, O Soma, slayer of enemies, wide-seeing, bringing blessing to the cow, fulfilling desire for the gods.

sanskrit: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase . manaścinmanasaspatiḥ
english: You are poured out, O Soma, for Indra to drink, for exhilaration. He is lord of the mind, the very embodiment of mind.

sanskrit: pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ . indavindreṇa no yujā
english: O purifying Soma, bestow on us wealth with excellent heroes. O drop, unite us with Indra.

sanskrit: yudhedāpitvamicchase astārameṣi sūrya
english: You seek fellowship even in battle; you go to the archer, O Sun.

sanskrit: na kī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ . yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā . ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt
english: You find no wealthy one for friendship; your horses drink eagerly. When you make the river roar and sweep it along, then you are called upon like a father, O new one. He who with the strength of his arms broke ninety-nine forts — and Vṛtrahan also slew the serpent.

sanskrit: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvadgomadyavamat . urudhāreva dohate
english: May that Indra, an auspicious friend, bring us what is rich in horses, in cattle, in barley. He is milked like a wide-flowing stream.

sanskrit: brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudhā vi rājati
english: O Indra, let your tawny, long-maned steeds yoked with prayer carry you for the drinking of Soma. He who, wind-impelled, protects the creatures of himself, sustains them manifoldly and reigns far and wide.

sanskrit: ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā . śitipṛṣṭhā vahatāṃ madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye vibhrāḍ bṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmaṃ divo dharuṇe satyamarpitam . amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā
english: May the two tawny steeds with peacock tails, white-backed, draw you in the golden chariot to drink of the honey-sweet pressing, to imbibe the rousing draught. The most glorious, sublimely borne, the mightiest winner of prizes — the true law of heaven set firm in its foundation — he was born as light, the slayer of enemies, the slayer of Vṛtra, the greatest slayer of Dasyus, the slayer of Asuras, the slayer of rivals.

sanskrit: pibā tvā3sya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva . pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat . viśvabhrāḍ bhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam
english: Drink of this, O lover of praise, of the pressed juice as one who drinks first. This pressing is adorned and savory; the lovely exhilaration rules it. This is the best and highest light among lights; it is called the great all-conquering, wealth-winning one. All-shining in splendor, the great Sun, visible far and wide, has spread broadly together with indestructible might.

sanskrit: vanaprakṣamudaprutam śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīva jyotiraśīmahi
english: O much-invoked one, instruct us in this path of him who springs up from the wood, who leaps upward. May we attain the light of life.

sanskrit: sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ payoduhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane . ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo3 māśivāso 'va kramuḥ . tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo 'ti śūra tarāmasi
english: The bull of a thousand streams, yielding milk, dear to the divine birth. He who, born of cosmic order, has grown mightily by cosmic order — the divine king, the great cosmic order. May unknown hostile places and malevolent beings not step down upon us; may the inauspicious not tread us down. With you, O hero, we shall cross over the waters flowing downward forever.

sanskrit: samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ viśvā ca no jaritR^īntsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ
english: The bright one kindled and offered — O lord of the good, protect all our singers both by day and by night.

sanskrit: garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare . sīdannṛtasya yonimā prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam . ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ
english: The father of the father, flashing in the womb of the mother, in the imperishable syllable, taking his seat in the lap of cosmic order — the crusher, the hero, the generous one, mighty in gifts, mingled together for vigor. Both your arms, O hundred-powered one, the bulls that have released the thunderbolt downward.

sanskrit: brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe . agne yaddīdayaddivi
english: Bring a prayer bearing offspring, O Jātavedas, wide-seeing, O Agni, that which shone in heaven.

sanskrit: sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā sarasvantaṃ havāmahe
english: The pressed one roaring goes around the purifying filter, like a friend to the dwelling. We call upon Sarasvan, the Hotṛ who possesses cattle.

sanskrit: bhadrā vastrā samanyā ' '3 vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan . ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau
english: Clothed in auspicious common garments, the great sage proclaiming utterances of praise — flow back into the two bowls as you are purified, wide-seeing, awake in the divine feast.

sanskrit: samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme . abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
english: The beloved one is also wiped clean on the woolen filter, the most glorious, dwelling among the glorious, among us. Sound forth, flowing through the straining cloth as you are purified. Do you always protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddhairāśīrvānmamattu sarasvatī stomyā bhūt
english: May Sarasvatī cherish him who has grown great with pure praises, who has pure blessings; may she be worthy of hymns.

sanskrit: indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ . śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somya
english: O pure Indra, come to us; pure, with pure aids. Being pure, hold wealth firm; being pure, rejoice in the Soma, O Soma-drinker.

sanskrit: indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe . śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi
english: O Indra, being pure you grant us wealth; pure, you bestow jewels on the worshiper. Being pure you smite the obstacles; being pure you will win the prize.

sanskrit: devasya draviṇasyavaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
english: May he who is the guardian of divine wealth inspire our prayers.
